versions.content: If data is transmitted using a socket which is bound to an IPv6 Unicast local address (TcpIpAddrId) the TcpIp shall use the IP address assigned to local address (TcpIpAddrId) as source IP address in the IP datagram header. The IP Specification of TCP/IP Stack AUTO SAR CP R20 - 11 45 of 293 Document ID 617 : AUTOSAR_SWS_TcpIp datagram shall be transmitted using the EthIfCtrl the local address (TcpIpAddrId) is mapped to.
